_meta.source: real capture 2026-07-30, 94 POST /v1/responses requests (93 main + 1 auto-review)
_meta.gap: none -- response format established from Codex source (codex-rs/codex-api/src/sse/responses.rs)

response_sse.minimum_viable: response.created + response.output_item.done (message/output_text item carrying the verdict JSON) + response.completed
response_sse.mandatory: response.completed only -- its absence is a fatal 'stream closed before response.completed'; delta events only drive display

fields.completed: response{id,usage,end_turn} -- usage MUST carry input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_output_tokens, total_tokens; an empty object fails the whole stream

response_sse.trap: Codex applies an idle timeout to the stream: start emitting without waiting for the computation to finish

endpoints.POST /v1/responses: all Codex traffic (main + auto-review), stream=true store=false
endpoints.GET /v1/models: cited by errors, not observed -- possibly validates model names

request_envelope.model: cerebras-gpt-oss-120b | codex-auto-review -- the ONLY routing discriminator
request_envelope.instructions: full system prompt, str ~20k chars, identical on every request
request_envelope.input: FULL history resent every turn (types: message, function_call, function_call_output)

message.note: assistant sometimes has empty text (checkpoints to strip); developer=<permissions instructions>; user=<environment_context> XML, AGENTS.md, prompts

function_call_output.output: metadata prefix 'Chunk ID/Wall time/Process exited/Original token count: N' + 'Output:\n' + body -- summarise ONLY the body, the prefix gives a free token count

guardian.role: judges ONE planned action: intrinsic risk x user authorization -> allow/deny
guardian.instructions: 18446 chars: Evidence Handling (trust: user/developer/AGENTS.md/request_user_input only), scoring user_authorization(unknown|low|medium|high), risk(low|medium|high|critical), per-category policy (exfiltration/credentials/security-weakening/destructive/low-risk), outcome policy: low,medium->allow; high->allow iff auth>=medium; critical->deny
input_3_messages: user: '# AGENTS.md instructions for <path>' + AGENTS.md content

user: multi-part input_text: intro 'untrusted evidence' -> '>>> TRANSCRIPT START' -> selective numbered entries '[N] user: ...' '[N] tool exec_command call: {json}' '[N] tool exec_command result: ...' -> 'Assess the exact planned action below' -> 'Planned action JSON:' -> {command[],cwd,justification,sandbox_permissions,tool,tty} -> '>>> APPROVAL REQUEST END'
tools: view_image -- read-only investigation; strip tools for a small model and force a direct answer
guardian.on_error: any HTTP error -> Codex rejects the action and forbids workarounds -> fail-safe already lives in Codex; a local error is acceptable, NEVER fabricate a default allow
guardian.backend_constraints: measured LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct on CPU: ingestion 11.65 tok/s, generation 6.11 tok/s -> relaying the full Guardian prompt (8k+ tok = ~11 min) is NOT VIABLE; strategy: deterministic pre-filter + rewritten prompt <=300 tok + JSON-schema output <=40 tok, temperature <=0.2 -- see DIRECTION.md M1.2/M1.3

compaction_facts.history_resent_every_turn: 2900 messages + 2004 call/output pairs over 93 requests in one session
compaction_facts.identical_instructions: prime candidate for provider prompt caching (prompt_cache_key already transmitted)
compaction_facts.free_token_count: every function_call_output announces 'Original token count: N' in its prefix
